purpose: U12: smoke test of the notebooks session image on at least 3 GPU models
gpu_models_note: Minimum is 3 distinct models; the fleet is the owner's decision. A session image keeps running, so this spec uses a `session` step (kits/README.md, Smoke test spec): kits/tools/smoke_runner.py starts the image like session_agent.build_session_argv (tcp mode) and talks to Jupyter with `docker exec -i <c> nc 127.0.0.1 8888`.

checks.expect: inside the container, `nc 127.0.0.1 8888` connects and GET /api/status over it returns 200 within 60 s
the server is not reachable from another address of the container and no port is published
a kernel running torch.cuda.is_available() returns true and names the GPU
run with --network none succeeds; an outbound connection from a kernel fails
starts with --read-only --tmpfs /tmp --cap-drop ALL as a non-root user; the workspace under /tmp/workspace is writable
